about: Protocol v0.2.2 conformance vectors (PROTOCOL.md). Each request is an 8-byte frame <HHi (type, address, value); each response is <hHi (status, address, value). A response value of null means any value is acceptable. Vectors run in order on one TCP connection to a freshly started device with the CNC profile, and leave its state as they found it.

vectors.name: A successful write echoes the written value
A read returns the value written
Writing a read-only register is refused
Reading past the register map is out of range
Writing past the parameter map is out of range
Reading past the system registers is out of range
An application command is acknowledged with SYS_COMMAND_OK
